title: Revue Starlight
native: 少女☆歌劇 レヴュー・スタァライト
synopsis:
The franchise centers on "Starlight" — the song and dance revue troupe loved throughout the world. Karen and Hikari make a promise with each other when they're young that one day they'll stand on that stage together. Time passes, and now the girls are 16 years old. Karen is very enthusiastic about the lessons she takes every day, holding her promise close to her heart. Hikari has transferred schools and is now away from Karen. But the cogs of fate turn, and the two are destined to meet again. The girls and other "Stage Girls" will compete in a mysterious audition process to gain acceptance into the revue.

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: Stage Girls
episodes.synopsis: The curtain rises on the performance of a lifetime as Karen and her classmates attend a prestigious music academy to become the next theatrical stars.

episodes.title: The Stage of Fate
episodes.synopsis: On the second day of the search for the next star, the girls accuse Karen of interfering with their auditions and not taking it as seriously as them.

episodes.title: Top Star
episodes.synopsis: Nana takes a role behind the scenes while Futaba notices that Claudine is bothered by something. Hikari is acting cold towards Karen, but is there a reason for it?

episodes.title: Promise Tower
episodes.synopsis: Hikari left campus, and Karen doesn’t understand why. Determined to find her friend, Karen searches for her throughout the city.

episodes.title: Is "Shine" Even Possible?
episodes.synopsis: Mahiru becomes increasingly dejected and jealous as Karen’s bond with Hikari strenghtens. Karen is spurred on with new determination, but where will this leave Mahiru?

episodes.title: Stage Left for Two
episodes.synopsis: Kaoruko fails to make the cut during class auditions and lashes out in indignation. Having earned a spot on stage, Futaba’s patience with Kaoruko reaches a boiling point.

episodes.title: Nana Daiba
episodes.synopsis: Nana Daiba’s memories of the acadamy’s 99th performance was a shining beacon crystalized in time. Can she ever move forward or will she be forever blinded by the past?

episodes.title: Toward the Light
episodes.synopsis: What’s past is prologue. The promise Hikari made with Karen is what fuels her determination, but life rarely occurs according to plan.

episodes.title: On the Night of the Star Festival
episodes.synopsis: Preparations for the next performance of Starlight continue, and everyone is filled with hope as they move forward. Everyone that is, except for Nana, who sinks into despair.

episodes.title: The Show Must Go On
episodes.synopsis: The final day has arrived and Karen and Hikari renew their vow to perform Starlight. Can they overcome the unforgiving audition and become Top Stars together?

episodes.title: We are
episodes.synopsis: Fate is cruel and harshly deals with any deviation from the pre-established script. What happens to those who dare defy the system the day after the performance?
